proof_body:
by
  intro x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ x₃ y₃
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, b, c, hab, h₁, h₂, h₃⟩
    have e₁ : a * (x₂ - x₁) + b * (y₂ - y₁) = 0 := by linarith
    have e₂ : a * (x₃ - x₁) + b * (y₃ - y₁) = 0 := by linarith
    have ha : a * ((x₂ - x₁) * (y₃ - y₁) - (y₂ - y₁) * (x₃ - x₁)) = 0 := by
      linear_combination (y₃ - y₁) * e₁ - (y₂ - y₁) * e₂
    have hb : b * ((x₂ - x₁) * (y₃ - y₁) - (y₂ - y₁) * (x₃ - x₁)) = 0 := by
      linear_combination (x₂ - x₁) * e₂ - (x₃ - x₁) * e₁
    by_contra hne
    have hD : (x₂ - x₁) * (y₃ - y₁) - (y₂ - y₁) * (x₃ - x₁) ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hne
    exact hab ⟨(mul_eq_zero.mp ha).resolve_right hD, (mul_eq_zero.mp hb).resolve_right hD⟩
  · intro h
    by_cases h₁ : x₂ - x₁ = 0 ∧ y₂ - y₁ = 0
    · by_cases h₂ : x₃ - x₁ = 0 ∧ y₃ - y₁ = 0
      · refine ⟨1, 0, x₁, by simp, by ring, ?_, ?_⟩
        · linarith [h₁.1]
        · linarith [h₂.1]
      · refine ⟨y₃ - y₁, x₁ - x₃, (y₃ - y₁) * x₁ + (x₁ - x₃) * y₁, ?_, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rintro ⟨h3, h4⟩
          exact h₂ ⟨by linarith, h3⟩
        · have e₁ : x₂ = x₁ := by linarith [h₁.1]
          have e₂ : y₂ = y₁ := by linarith [h₁.2]
          rw [e₁, e₂]
        · ring
    · refine ⟨y₂ - y₁, x₁ - x₂, (y₂ - y₁) * x₁ + (x₁ - x₂) * y₁, ?_, rfl, by ring, ?_⟩
      · rintro ⟨h3, h4⟩
        exact h₁ ⟨by linarith, h3⟩
      · linear_combination -h
target_source: ∀ (x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ x₃ y₃ : ℝ), (∃ a b c : ℝ, ¬(a = 0 ∧ b = 0) ∧ a * x₁ + b * y₁ = c ∧ a * x₂ + b * y₂ = c ∧ a * x₃ + b * y₃ = c) ↔ (x₂ - x₁) * (y₃ - y₁) = (y₂ - y₁) * (x₃ - x₁)
